steps.answer: This queue handled more contacts than the plan expected: 1686.0 against a forecast of 1118.6, which is about 43% above its normal weekly level.

steps.answer: System-wide. The same miss is already visible at Channel level (CSG / APJ / SA / Malaysia / Email), so this queue did not cause it and correcting this queue alone would not fix it.
